name.full: Zava One Hub Plugin - Your connected workplace

description.short: Zava news, personal work, and employee services.
description.full: An independently packaged plug-in for the fictional Zava company. Open focused experiences for company news, trusted answers, personal work, employee services, recognition, business insights, and manager decisions. Includes a dedicated Zava One Hub agent and a connector to the separately deployed Zava One Hub SPFx solution. Uses fictional, session-local demo data; no real workplace transactions are submitted.

agentConnectors.description: Open focused Zava company and employee experiences, or explore the connected workplace. Tools render SPFx Copilot UX components from the separately deployed Zava One Hub solution.
